jobs.sourceName: Veeva Systems official Lever careers posting
jobs.desc: Veeva Systems is hiring an Associate Software Engineer in Test Automation for its Hyderabad QA and Release Engineering team. The position supports quality engineering for the Veeva Vault platform and applications, including analysis of opportunities for automated testing and the creation and maintenance of API and UI automation tests. The official posting highlights collaboration with team leads, daily use of CI/CD tools, and technologies such as Java, Cucumber, AWS, Git, Jenkins and Jira. This is a full-time on-site role.
jobs.elig: The official requirements include 1+ years of software test automation experience, strong Java and object-oriented programming knowledge, Agile/Scrum familiarity, effective communication, and a bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Applications or a similar field. Selenium, Cucumber, life-sciences experience and additional CI/CD tools are desirable rather than mandatory.
resp: Learn the features of the Veeva Vault platform and its applications.
Assess the automation feasibility of assigned test cases.
Develop and maintain API and UI automated test scripts.
Use Git, Jenkins and Jira in daily development and validation.
Coordinate progress and status with onshore managers and team leads.

jobs.role: Analyst - Pricing and Market Access Consulting
jobs.sourceName: Precision AQ official Greenhouse careers posting
jobs.desc: Precision AQ Consulting is recruiting an Analyst for its India-based Global Pricing and Market Access strategic consulting team. The role supports international life-sciences and pharmaceutical consulting projects by undertaking market and desk research, developing research instruments and client-ready presentations, conducting quantitative and qualitative analysis, and helping teams derive insights for launch pricing, reimbursement, market access and product-value communication. The listing describes flexible office, home and hybrid work, with the location tagged Remote, India.
jobs.elig: A bachelor's or master's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Public Health, Health Economics, Economics, Engineering, or an MBA, with 2 years of relevant experience in consulting, pharmaceutical market access, HEOR, competitive intelligence or healthcare and life-sciences research. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in India without employer sponsorship.
resp: Gather secondary research from internal databases, published literature, payer and HTA sites and industry sources.
Develop discussion guides, interview screeners and other primary-research materials.
Participate in global healthcare stakeholder interviews and independently conduct them as proficiency grows.
Conduct desk research to answer client questions.
Build structured client-ready presentations with actionable insights.
Apply qualitative and quantitative analyses to support pricing and market-access recommendations.
